title: Port Chester NY Baby, Beaded Wooden Chair - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Port Chester, New York, United States
description: An intimate black-and-white outdoor snapshot capturing a baby sitting in a wooden youth rocking chair equipped with sliding wooden play beads across the front bar. Taken during the height of the Great Depression on August 14, 1932, in Port Chester, New York, the toddler wears light-colored clothing and white booties or socks while seated outside against a garden hedge backdrop.
